business."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty P&C for small and mid-sized businesses through agents and brokers, matching Hanover's commercial specialty insurance."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Insurance broker earning commissions and fees without underwriting risk, unlike Hanover's premium-funded risk-bearing model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced claims adjusting service for insurers, not an insurer bearing risk and collecting premiums."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Online with no underwriting or policy risk."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Annuity and life insurer focused on retirement savings, a different customer and product set from Hanover's P&C business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Franchise agency network earning commissions on placed policies, not an insurer that underwrites risk."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Small regional P&C insurer writing commercial, homeowners and personal auto through independent agents, matching Hanover's core lines."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Its general P&C lines, such as workers' compensation and commercial auto, match Hanover, though title and mortgage guaranty are large separate businesses."},{"label":"C13","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty property and surplus lines risks through agents and MGAs, comparable to Hanover's specialty commercial insurance."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Life insurance, mortgage lending and cemetery operations, with no property and casualty underwriting overlap."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Title insurance with escrow, data and software serving real estate transactions, a different risk and customer base."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning commissions and fees rather than underwriting insured risk."},{"label":"C17","good":false,"reason":"Independent retail insurance agency earning commissions from carriers, not an underwriting insurer."},{"label":"C18","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites specialty commercial liability, property and workers' compensation through independent agents, closely matching Hanover."}]}
